title: Investigating restorative effects of biophilic design in workplaces: a systematic review
authors: Muhammed Yildirim, Ozgur Gocer, Anastasia Globa & Arianna Brambilla, 2024
review_question: What type of biophilic design patterns have been studied in workplaces? What are the evidence-based restorative benefits of biophilic design implementations in a workplace for its employees? What are the effect sizes of each individual biophilic design pattern on employees in workplaces?
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed journal articles and conference proceedings published between 2010 and 2022 (inclusive), full-text available in English. Studies dealing with biophilic design principles through exposure to elements and features of nature in indoor/semi-outdoor workplace environments, and reporting impact on employees using primary or secondary data.

synthesis_conclusions: The inclusion of greenery, access to natural views, and well-designed daylight yielded considerable positive impacts in the workplace.
The refined biophilic design framework developed in this study can serve as a valuable resource for design teams to create healthy, productive, comfortable, and stress-free workplaces.
evidence_gaps: Further research is needed to consolidate the evidence regarding the potential restorative benefits of several biophilic design patterns that have been relatively underexplored in the existing literature.
Additional studies are required to examine the role of biophilic workplaces in enhancing employees' mood states, as this aspect has been notably understudied in comparison to other workplace metrics.
risk_of_bias_assessment: Paper quality was a criterion in the AHP analysis, using journal ranking system (Scimago Journal & Country Rank 2023) to identify quality.
limitations: A range of biophilic design strategies exhibited negligible impacts on the outcome measures, which contrasts with findings in some studies.
Strategies displayed minimal effect sizes across outcome measures primarily due to their relatively limited representation in the available literature.
Lack of outcome data on some biophilic design strategies might be resulted from missing evidence in the systematic review.
Systematic reviews can still fail to provide complete and up-to-date evidence on a specific research question.
Reliance on subjective judgments in AHP analysis when identifying evaluation criteria and establishing their relative importance, introducing bias and leading to inconsistent results.
Expert advice could have been sought when assessing the quality of papers.

theory_commitments.specific_claim: Natural environments facilitate recovery from directed attention fatigue through fascination, being away, extent, and compatibility.
Non-threatening natural environments elicit an immediate, unreflective, positive affective response and reduce physiological arousal.

mechanism_chain.description: Biophilic design elements contribute to restorative effects through various perceptual, cognitive, affective, and physiological pathways.

steps.from_construct: exposure to natural elements (e.g., greenery, natural light)
steps.to_construct: increased feelings of fascination and being away

steps.from_construct: increased feelings of fascination and being away

steps.to_construct: reduced physiological arousal (e.g., lower heart rate, cortisol)
